Test: test_payment_gateway_charge_success (suite: payments-integration)
Failure message: ReadTimeoutError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.paymentsvc.internal', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=5)
Stack trace: requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout at payments/client.py:112 in charge_card
Root cause: Payment service sandbox occasionally takes 6-9s under load; test timeout was hardcoded to 5s.
Resolution: Increased client read timeout to 15s for sandbox environment and added retry-with-backoff wrapper.
Tags: timeout, payments, flaky, external-dependency
